title: Review decision
description: A trusted human review record. Maintainer-controlled: files under registries/reviewers/decisions/ are written by maintainers through the protected review workflow, never by content contributors or agents. A lifecycle status of 'approved' without a matching decision bound to the exact record hash is not approval.

record_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of the reviewed record's content fields. Any change invalidates this decision.

reviewer.description: Registered reviewer ID (registries/reviewers). Must be a real consenting human; agents never fill this.

invalidated.description: Set by maintainers when the record, its sources, rights basis or dependent claims change.
